definitions.explanation: Having a negative outlook on life or situations, expecting unfavorable outcomes.

examples.japanese: {悲観的|ひかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならないで→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悲観的|ひかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She tends to see things pessimistically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先行|さきゆ}き→先行き：27497_sakiyuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悲観的|ひかんてき}な⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many pessimistic forecasts about the economic outlook.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: {悲観的|ひかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (pessimistically)
- Noun: ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧ (pessimism)
- Verb: ⟦{悲観|ひかん}する→悲観：22397_hikan⟧ (to be pessimistic)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {悲観的|ひかんてき}な⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧/⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (pessimistic view/thinking)
- {悲観的|ひかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (think pessimistically)
- {悲観的|ひかんてき}な⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧ (pessimistic forecast)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ネガティブ→ネガティブ：29634_negatibu⟧ (negative) - more casual, loanword
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き→後ろ向き：16690_ushiromuki⟧ (backward-looking) - emphasizes reluctant attitude
